source.author: Abraham Baer
source.title: Baal t’fillah oder Der practische Vorbeter
source.heading: Die Intonation der Accente (נגינות) nach sephardischem Ritus.
source.imageAlt: Baer [1894] No938 p209: complete printed Sephardic accent-name intonation table, with source context retained.
source.institution: Universitätsbibliothek Johann Christian Senckenberg, Frankfurt am Main
source.cropPixels: Unretouched lossless PNG crop from the pinned institutional JPEG; includes the table heading, all27groups and surrounding printed context.
source.rights: Original nineteenth-century print public domain; Frankfurt institutional digitization policy permits unrestricted public-domain digitization reuse. New literal transcription CC0-1.0.
source.upstreamCredit: Baer contents pXL credits Nos937–943 to S. Naumbourg’s Agudas Schirim; The credited earlier table has been located: Naumbourg1874, No62 printedp103. It is a comparison source, not an independent musical review.
source.footnoteScope: The African/Moroccan footnote’s asterisk attaches to No937 Lecha Dodi above. It does not establish a Moroccan label for No938; the actual No938 heading says Sephardic.

upstreamComparison.title: Recueil de chants religieux et populaires des Israélites
upstreamComparison.author: Samuel Naumbourg
upstreamComparison.heading: TABLE DES ACCENTS TONIQUES DU RITE DES SEFARDIM
upstreamComparison.status: Located and visually inspected primary credited table, not an independent transcription/cantorial review. No musical values were copied into BaerNo938 from this source.
upstreamComparison.finding: The earlier print places the same caption sequence across six staff lines, and explicitly labels the second Sof pasouk form VARIANTE. The following No63 is a Genesis chapterI worked example. BaerNo938 remains the authoritative playable edition; detailed edition differences and accepted modern sign aliases remain unassigned.

sourceKey.label: No key signature or meter printed. Candidate local accidental carry follows each printed division; historical tuning remains unassigned.

scope: Literal27printed accent-name intonation groups on p209, associated with the following No939Genesis1:1–5 worked example. No arbitrary Bible-word application, named Kinnor preset or complete tradition grammar is asserted.
